description:

dataSourceDetails.query: SELECT "siem_persistence_persistence_152", "data__json.rEventName" FROM "oci_monitoring_metricexplorer_metrics" WHERE "compartmentId" = '$COMPARTMENT_ID' AND "namespace" = 'AuditEvents' AND "data__json.rEventName" LIKE '%browser%' AND "value" > 0
